def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter(v for row in g for v in row); bg=counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    axis,pos,dc=None,None,None
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg: axis,pos,dc='row',r,row[0]; break
    if axis is None:
        for c in range(w):
            if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and g[0][c]!=bg: axis,pos,dc='col',c,g[0][c]; break
    oc=next(v for v in counts if v not in (bg,dc))
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==oc]
    if axis=='row':
        lo=min(r for r,c in cells); hi=max(r for r,c in cells)
        shift=(pos-1-hi) if hi<pos else (pos+1-lo)
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r+shift][c]=oc
        lo+=shift; hi+=shift
        mark=lo-1 if hi<pos else hi+1
        g[mark]=[8]*w
    else:
        lo=min(c for r,c in cells); hi=max(c for r,c in cells)
        shift=(pos-1-hi) if hi<pos else (pos+1-lo)
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c+shift]=oc
        lo+=shift; hi+=shift
        mark=lo-1 if hi<pos else hi+1
        for r in range(h): g[r][mark]=8
    return g
